lewisham.zh: 劉易舍姆（英國倫敦的一個行政區）
ai: Lewisham is a borough in south-east London.
劉易舍姆是倫敦東南部的一個行政區。
We took the train to Lewisham to visit a friend.
我們搭火車去劉易舍姆拜訪朋友。
He bowed his head in contrition after breaking his promise.
他違背承諾後，懊悔地低下了頭。
She wrote a letter full of contrition to apologize.
她寫了一封充滿悔意的信來道歉。
Telecommuting saves her two hours of travel every day.
遠距上班讓她每天省下兩小時的通勤時間。
Many companies now allow telecommuting a few days a week.
許多公司現在允許員工每週有幾天遠距上班。

bethlehem.zh: 伯利恆（位於中東的城市，傳統上被視為耶穌的誕生地）
ai: Bethlehem is a city in the West Bank.
伯利恆是約旦河西岸的一座城市。
Many pilgrims travel to Bethlehem at Christmas.
許多朝聖者在聖誕節時前往伯利恆。
The vandalism of the old church was seen as desecration.
老教堂遭人破壞被視為一種褻瀆。
Locals were angry about the desecration of the graveyard.
當地居民對墓園遭到玷汙感到憤怒。

pensionable.zh: 可領退休金的；符合領退休金資格的
ai: He is nearing pensionable age and plans to retire soon.
他接近可領退休金的年紀，打算很快退休。
Only full-time staff receive pensionable salary.
只有全職員工的薪資才計入退休金。

screened.zh: 篩檢；過濾（screen 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: All visitors were screened before entering the building.
所有訪客進入大樓前都先接受了檢查。
The hospital screened patients for the virus at the door.
醫院在門口對病人進行病毒篩檢。

screened.zh: 放映；播出（screen 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The film was screened at a small theater last night.
這部電影昨晚在一間小戲院放映。
The documentary was screened on television last week.
這部紀錄片上週在電視上播出。
We eat dinner on the screened porch in summer.
夏天我們在裝了紗窗的門廊吃晚餐。
They built a screened area to keep the bugs out.
他們蓋了一處裝有紗網的空間來擋蟲。

hearted.zh: 有……心腸的（常用於複合詞）
ai: She is a warm-hearted woman who helps everyone.
她是個心腸溫暖的女人，樂於幫助每個人。
The kind-hearted driver waited for the old man.
那位心地善良的司機等著那位老先生。

barmy.zh: 傻氣的；瘋瘋癲癲的（英式口語）
ai: That's a barmy idea, and it will never work.
那是個瘋狂的點子，絕對行不通。
My uncle is a bit barmy, but everyone loves him.
我叔叔有點瘋瘋癲癲的，但大家都喜歡他。

fulfilling.zh: 有成就感的；令人滿足的
ai: She has a fulfilling job teaching young children.
她有一份教幼童的工作，很有成就感。
Volunteering has been a fulfilling experience for him.
當志工對他來說是一段很充實的經驗。

fulfilling.zh: 實現；履行（fulfill 的現在分詞）
ai: He is fulfilling his dream of becoming a chef.
他正在實現成為廚師的夢想。
The company is fulfilling orders as fast as it can.
公司正盡快完成訂單。

janeiro.zh: 里約熱內盧（Rio de Janeiro）名稱的後半部
ai: Rio de Janeiro is a famous city in Brazil.
里約熱內盧是巴西的一座著名城市。
The name Janeiro is the Portuguese word for January.
Janeiro 這個字在葡萄牙語中是一月的意思。
The runner broke his tibia during the match.
那位跑者在比賽中摔斷了脛骨。
The tibia is the larger bone in the lower leg.
脛骨是小腿中較粗的那根骨頭。
The pitcher threw a curveball and the batter missed.
投手投出一顆曲球，打者揮棒落空。
It is hard to hit a curveball when you cannot see the spin.
看不清旋轉時，很難擊中曲球。
The sudden schedule change threw us a curveball.
突然更改的時程給我們出了個意外的難題。
Life threw her a curveball when the shop closed.
店面歇業，讓她的人生遇上了意想不到的考驗。
The old schoolroom had a stove and a dozen wooden desks.
那間舊教室裡有一個爐子和十幾張木桌。
Children's drawings covered the walls of the schoolroom.
教室牆上貼滿了孩子們的畫。
The film was criticized for its indecency.
這部電影因其猥褻內容而受到批評。
He was fined for public indecency.
他因公然有傷風化而被罰款。
Scientists studied the relatedness of the two species.
科學家研究了這兩個物種之間的親緣關係。
The relatedness between the two ideas is not obvious.
這兩個概念之間的關聯並不明顯。
The bank must prove its solvency to the regulators.
這家銀行必須向主管機關證明自己有償付能力。
Rising debts put the firm's solvency at risk.
不斷增加的債務讓公司的償付能力陷入危機。
Video conferencing lets us meet without traveling.
視訊會議讓我們不必出差就能開會。
The office installed new conferencing equipment last month.
辦公室上個月裝了新的會議設備。
The farmer sold a yearling at the spring market.
農夫在春季市集賣了一匹一歲的小馬。
A yearling is still growing and needs plenty of food.
一歲的幼獸還在成長，需要很多食物。

plenary.zh: 全體出席的；全體會議的
ai: All members attended the plenary session this morning.
所有成員都出席了今早的全體會議。
The plenary meeting will vote on the new rules.
全體大會將就新規定進行表決。
She felt humiliated when everyone laughed at her mistake.
大家嘲笑她的錯誤時，她覺得非常丟臉。
He left the room humiliated and angry.
他又羞又氣地離開了房間。

humiliated.zh: 使蒙羞；羞辱（humiliate 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The coach humiliated the player in front of the team.
教練當著全隊的面羞辱了那名球員。
She was humiliated by the harsh comments online.
她被網路上刻薄的留言羞辱了。
The warder unlocked the heavy gate for the visitors.
看守員為訪客打開了沉重的大門。
A warder walked the corridor every hour at night.
夜間每個小時都有一名看守員在走廊巡視。
We left the highway and took a quiet byway through the hills.
我們離開公路，走上穿越山丘的寧靜小路。
The village lies on a narrow byway few tourists find.
這個村子位在一條少有遊客知道的窄路旁。
The living room was tastefully decorated in soft colors.
客廳以柔和的色調佈置得很雅緻。
She dressed tastefully for the dinner party.
她為晚宴穿著得體而高雅。
In the old play, the main character is a famous shrew.
在那齣老戲劇裡，主角是個出了名的潑婦。
He called her a shrew, and she was furious.
他罵她是潑婦，她氣壞了。
The keys jangled in his pocket as he walked.
他走路時，口袋裡的鑰匙叮噹作響。
Her bracelets jangle every time she waves.
她每次揮手，手鐲都會叮噹作響。
I woke up to the jangle of the alarm bell.
我被刺耳的鈴聲吵醒。
The jangle of coins filled the empty room.
硬幣的叮噹聲充滿了空蕩的房間。
My younger brother is asthmatic and carries an inhaler.
我弟弟有氣喘，隨身帶著吸入器。
Cold air can trigger an asthmatic cough.
冷空氣可能引發氣喘的咳嗽。
He was too inhibited to dance in front of others.
他太拘謹，不敢在別人面前跳舞。
Wine made the shy guests feel less inhibited.
酒讓害羞的客人放鬆了些。

inhibited.zh: 抑制；阻礙（inhibit 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The drug inhibited the growth of the bacteria.
這種藥物抑制了細菌的生長。
Fear inhibited her from speaking up in class.
恐懼讓她不敢在課堂上發言。

pierced.zh: 刺穿；穿透（pierce 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The nail pierced the tire and the air rushed out.
釘子刺穿了輪胎，空氣迅速漏出。
A beam of light pierced the dark clouds.
一道光穿透了烏雲。
She had her ears pierced when she was twelve.
她十二歲時穿了耳洞。

wrapped.zh: 包；裹（wrap 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She wrapped the gift in blue paper.
她用藍色包裝紙把禮物包好。
He wrapped a scarf around his neck.
他把圍巾圍在脖子上。
The wrapped sandwiches are on the kitchen table.
包好的三明治在廚房桌上。
The baby slept, wrapped in a warm blanket.
寶寶裹著暖和的毯子睡著了。
In some beliefs, souls wait in purgatory before heaven.
在某些信仰中，靈魂在進入天堂前會先待在煉獄。
Waiting for the test results was pure purgatory.
等待檢驗結果簡直是煎熬。

showman.zh: 表演主持人；善於表演的人
ai: The circus showman greeted the crowd with a big smile.
馬戲團的主持人笑容滿面地迎接觀眾。
He is a real showman who knows how to excite an audience.
他真是個很會炒熱氣氛的表演高手。
We took a circuitous route to avoid the traffic.
我們繞了遠路以避開車潮。
His circuitous explanation confused everyone.
他拐彎抹角的解釋讓大家一頭霧水。
He lit the candle with a single matchstick.
他用一根火柴棒點燃了蠟燭。
The kids built a tiny house out of matchsticks.
孩子們用火柴棒蓋了一間小房子。
The symphonic music filled the concert hall.
交響樂的樂聲迴盪在音樂廳裡。
She plays the flute in a symphonic orchestra.
她在交響樂團裡吹長笛。
The video was irrefutable proof that he was there.
那段影片是他當時在場的無可辯駁的證據。
She made an irrefutable argument, and no one replied.
她提出無可辯駁的論點，沒人能回應。
Her vivacious personality made her popular at school.
她活潑開朗的個性使她在學校很受歡迎。
The vivacious host kept the party lively all evening.
那位活潑的主人讓派對整晚都很熱鬧。
The critic wrote a vitriolic review of the new play.
評論家對這齣新戲寫了一篇尖酸刻薄的評論。
He sent a vitriolic email that he later regretted.
他寄出一封措辭尖刻的電子郵件，後來很後悔。
He gave a vacuous smile and said nothing useful.
他露出空洞的微笑，什麼有用的話也沒說。
The speech was full of vacuous promises.
那場演講充滿了空洞的承諾。
The weather was uncommonly warm for December.
就十二月而言，天氣異常溫暖。
She is uncommonly kind to strangers.
她對陌生人格外和善。

folksy.zh: 平易近人的；樸實親切的
ai: The mayor has a folksy way of talking to voters.
市長和選民說話的方式平易近人又親切。
The cafe has a folksy charm with its wooden tables.
那間咖啡館有著木桌帶來的質樸魅力。
The winner was magnanimous and praised his rival.
獲勝者很大方地稱讚了他的對手。
It was magnanimous of her to forgive them so quickly.
她這麼快就原諒他們，真是寬宏大量。
The teacher forewarned us that the test would be hard.
老師預先警告我們考試會很難。
I should forewarn you that the road is closed.
我得先提醒你，那條路封閉了。
The spa offers a weekend of rest and rejuvenation.
這間水療中心提供週末休息與恢復活力的行程。
The city plans the rejuvenation of its old downtown.
這座城市計畫讓老市區重新恢復活力。
Stop bandying my name around the office.
別再在辦公室裡到處亂提我的名字了。
Fans bandied theories about the ending online.
影迷們在網路上來回討論結局的各種說法。
The old dog had bandy legs but ran fast.
那隻老狗雖然腿向外彎，卻跑得很快。
He walked with a slightly bandy gait.
他走路時雙腿微微向外彎。

hasidic.zh: 哈西德派的（猶太教的一個支派）
ai: The Hasidic community in the neighborhood runs several schools.
這個社區裡的哈西德派群體開辦了幾所學校。
He studied Hasidic stories for his history class.
他為了歷史課研讀哈西德派的故事。

wacko.zh: 古怪的；瘋瘋癲癲的（口語）
ai: My neighbor has some wacko ideas about gardening.
我鄰居對園藝有些古怪的想法。
That's a wacko plan, but it might actually work.
那是個瘋狂的計畫，但說不定真的行得通。
The soldier was praised for his valour.
那名士兵因英勇而受到讚揚。
The story tells of a knight's valour and kindness.
這個故事講述一位騎士的英勇與善良。
She likes an uncluttered desk when she studies.
她讀書時喜歡桌面保持整齊。
The uncluttered design makes the website easy to use.
簡潔不雜亂的設計讓這個網站很好用。

conflicted.zh: 抵觸；衝突（conflict 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The meeting conflicted with my doctor's appointment.
那場會議和我的看診時間衝突了。
Their opinions conflicted, so the debate went on.
他們的意見相左，所以辯論持續下去。
A theocracy is ruled by religious leaders.
神權政治由宗教領袖統治。
The history book describes how the old theocracy fell.
這本歷史書描述了那個古老神權國家如何衰亡。
Old alchemists hoped to transmute lead into gold.
古代煉金術士希望把鉛變成黃金。
She tried to transmute her sadness into art.
她試著把悲傷轉化為藝術。

unobstructed.zh: 沒有阻礙的；視野開闊的
ai: The hotel room has an unobstructed view of the sea.
這間飯店房間可以毫無遮擋地看到海景。
Keep the exit unobstructed at all times.
出口處隨時都要保持暢通。
Cellulose gives plant cell walls their strength.
纖維素讓植物的細胞壁很堅韌。
Paper is made mostly from cellulose in wood.
紙張主要由木頭中的纖維素製成。
It was a propitious time to start a new business.
那是開創新事業的有利時機。
The clear sky was a propitious sign for the trip.
晴朗的天空是這趟旅行的好兆頭。
The author's last novel was published posthumously.
那位作者的最後一部小說在他死後出版。
She was posthumously awarded a medal for bravery.
她在身後被追贈了一枚勇氣勳章。
He plonked his bag on the table and sat down.
他把包包往桌上一放，坐了下來。
She plonked herself on the sofa after work.
她下班後一屁股坐到沙發上。
We only had cheap plonk to serve at the party.
派對上我們只有便宜的葡萄酒可招待。
He bought a bottle of plonk for the picnic.
他為野餐買了一瓶便宜的葡萄酒。
He spoke in a raspy voice because of his cold.
他因為感冒，說話聲音沙啞。
The old singer's raspy tone suited the blues song.
那位老歌手沙啞的嗓音很適合藍調歌曲。
She looked at the future optimistically.
她樂觀地看待未來。
The team optimistically expects to finish early.
團隊樂觀地預期能提早完成。
He chewed on the nub of an old pencil.
他咬著一小截舊鉛筆。
The nub of the problem is a lack of time.
問題的核心在於時間不夠。
The coach timed the race with a stopwatch.
教練用碼錶為賽跑計時。
I pressed the button on the stopwatch to start.
我按下碼錶的按鈕開始計時。
She painted the poster with gouache.
她用不透明水彩畫了那張海報。
Gouache dries fast and has a matte finish.
不透明水彩乾得快，成品是霧面的。
Grandparents often dote on their grandchildren.
祖父母常常溺愛孫子孫女。
He dotes on his little daughter and buys her everything.
他很疼愛他的小女兒，什麼都買給她。
The dog waited loyally at the door for hours.
那隻狗忠心地在門口等了好幾個小時。
She served the company loyally for thirty years.
她忠誠地為公司服務了三十年。
He lopped a branch off the tree.
他從樹上砍下一根樹枝。
The gardener lopped the tops of the bushes.
園丁剪掉了灌木叢的頂端。
His legalistic approach ignored the spirit of the rule.
他拘泥條文的做法忽略了規定的精神。
The contract is too legalistic for ordinary readers.
這份合約的法律條文味太重，一般讀者難以閱讀。

leaking.zh: 漏水；漏氣（leak 的現在分詞）
ai: The roof is leaking again after the heavy rain.
大雨過後屋頂又在漏水了。
A leaking pipe flooded the kitchen floor.
一根漏水的水管讓廚房地板淹了水。
Someone is leaking company secrets to the press.
有人把公司機密洩漏給媒體。
The staff were fired for leaking private information.
員工因洩漏私人資料而被解僱。
The leather is soft and pliable.
這塊皮革柔軟又好彎折。
Young children are more pliable than adults.
小孩子比成人更容易受影響。
The ceremony celebrates the oneness of the community.
這場典禮慶祝社區的團結一心。
Many people feel a oneness with nature on a hike.
許多人在健行時感到與大自然合而為一。
She earned a baccalaureate in biology.
她取得了生物學的學士學位。
A baccalaureate usually takes four years to complete.
學士學位通常需要四年完成。
The children ran joyfully into the garden.
孩子們開心地跑進花園。
She joyfully opened the box and found a puppy.
她開心地打開盒子，發現裡面是一隻小狗。
The cityscape glowed beautifully at night.
夜晚的城市景觀閃耀著美麗的光。
From the tower, we saw the whole cityscape.
我們從塔上看見了整片城市風光。
Our team spent an hour brainstorming new ideas.
我們團隊花了一小時腦力激盪想新點子。
Brainstorming works best when nobody judges the ideas.
腦力激盪在沒人批評點子時效果最好。
The old photos caused great hilarity at dinner.
那些舊照片讓晚餐時笑聲不斷。
There was hilarity in the room when he fell off the chair.
他從椅子上摔下來時，房間裡爆出一陣笑聲。
She gave him a saucy smile and walked away.
她對他俏皮一笑便走開了。
The waiter made a saucy joke about the menu.
服務生開了個關於菜單的調皮玩笑。

grasping.zh: 抓住；理解（grasp 的現在分詞）
ai: The baby was grasping her finger tightly.
寶寶緊緊抓著她的手指。
He is slowly grasping how the system works.
他漸漸理解這個系統是怎麼運作的。
The grasping landlord raised the rent again.
那位貪心的房東又調漲了房租。
Nobody trusted the grasping businessman.
沒有人信任那個貪得無厭的商人。
We relaxed at the poolside all afternoon.
我們整個下午都在泳池邊放鬆。
The hotel serves drinks at the poolside.
飯店在泳池邊提供飲料。
They had a poolside lunch under the umbrella.
他們在傘下享用泳池邊的午餐。
The poolside bar opens at noon.
泳池邊的酒吧中午開門。
His forgetfulness gets worse when he is tired.
他一累就更健忘。
She blamed her forgetfulness on a busy week.
她把自己的健忘歸咎於忙碌的一週。
Use a peeler to remove the skin from the potatoes.
用削皮器把馬鈴薯的皮削掉。
I bought a new peeler for the kitchen.
我為廚房買了一支新的削皮器。
The teacher praised the class for its attentiveness.
老師稱讚全班上課很專注。
The waiter's attentiveness made the dinner pleasant.
服務生的細心周到讓這頓晚餐很愉快。

courting.zh: 追求；招致（court 的現在分詞）
ai: He has been courting her for almost a year.
他追求她將近一年了。
Speeding all the time is courting disaster.
老是超速等於是在自招災禍。
Each hair grows from a tiny follicle in the skin.
每根頭髮都從皮膚裡的一個小毛囊長出來。
An infected follicle can look like a small red bump.
發炎的毛囊看起來可能像個紅色小腫塊。
The soldiers shared a deep sense of comradeship.
士兵們之間有著深厚的同袍情誼。
Team sports build comradeship among students.
團體運動能增進學生之間的夥伴情誼。
The coach had an avuncular way of giving advice.
那位教練給建議時有種長輩般的和藹。
He gave the nervous boy an avuncular smile.
他對那位緊張的男孩露出和藹長輩般的微笑。
The cliffs have chalky white rock.
那些懸崖有白堊質的白色岩石。
The medicine tasted chalky and bitter.
這藥吃起來有粉筆味而且很苦。
She worked with great ardour on the project.
她滿懷熱忱地投入這個專案。
His ardour for music never faded.
他對音樂的熱情從未消退。
The tap water here is potable.
這裡的自來水可以飲用。
The camp has no potable water, so bring your own.
營地沒有飲用水，所以要自己帶。
Their song was the leadoff to the evening show.
他們的歌曲是晚間演出的開場。
She was chosen as the leadoff in the relay race.
她被選為接力賽的第一棒。
Rudolph is a male given name.
魯道夫是一個男子名。
My friend's dog is named Rudolph.
我朋友的狗叫做魯道夫。
The old paper had turned brownish with age.
那張舊紙隨著年代變成了褐黃色。
She has brownish hair and green eyes.
她有一頭微棕的頭髮和綠色的眼睛。
The new rule was uncontroversial and passed quickly.
這項新規定沒有爭議，很快就通過了。
Choosing a lunch spot is rarely uncontroversial in our office.
在我們辦公室，選午餐地點很少是沒有爭議的事。
The golfer started his backswing slowly.
那位高爾夫球手緩慢地開始後擺。
A short backswing helps you keep control of the club.
較短的後擺有助於你掌控球桿。
He felt an unaccountable fear in the empty house.
他在空屋裡感到一股莫名的恐懼。
There was an unaccountable delay at the airport.
機場出現了無法解釋的延誤。
We put new shelving in the garage.
我們在車庫裝了新的架子。
The shelving holds all my books and files.
這些擱板放著我所有的書和文件。
He bought an ultralight tent for the hike.
他為健行買了一頂超輕的帳篷。
The ultralight bike is easy to carry upstairs.
這輛超輕的自行車很容易扛上樓。
Their camping trip ended in a funny misadventure.
他們的露營之旅以一場有趣的倒楣事收場。
He told us about his misadventure with the lost luggage.
他跟我們說了行李遺失的倒楣遭遇。

remorseless.zh: 冷酷無情的；毫不悔改的
ai: The remorseless heat lasted all week.
毫不留情的酷熱持續了一整週。
He was a remorseless critic who never praised anyone.
他是個冷酷的批評者，從不稱讚任何人。
The heat exchanger keeps the building warm.
熱交換器讓這棟建築保持溫暖。
The engineer replaced the broken exchanger in the system.
工程師換掉了系統中壞掉的交換器。
Workers handled the detonator with great care.
工人們非常小心地處理雷管。
The old building was brought down using a detonator.
那棟舊建築是用引爆裝置拆除的。
Three workers had to manhandle the piano up the stairs.
三名工人得用人力把鋼琴搬上樓。
The guards were accused of manhandling the protesters.
警衛被指控粗暴對待抗議者。
The shop gave out a freebie with every order.
那家店每筆訂單都附贈一份免費贈品。
I took the freebie pen from the booth.
我從攤位上拿了免費贈送的筆。
She has longish hair that she ties back.
她有一頭稍長的頭髮，通常綁起來。
It was a longish walk to the station.
到車站要走一段稍長的路。
Please disinfect the table after you eat.
用餐後請把桌子消毒。
Nurses disinfect their hands before seeing each patient.
護理師在看每位病人之前都會消毒雙手。
The crowd broke into jubilation when the team won.
球隊獲勝時，群眾爆出歡呼。
There was great jubilation in the streets that night.
那天晚上街頭一片歡騰。
The train whooshed past the platform.
火車呼嘯著駛過月台。
Cars whoosh by on the highway all night.
整晚都有車子在公路上呼嘯而過。
The door closed with a whoosh of air.
門隨著一陣呼的風聲關上了。
I heard the whoosh of a bike passing by.
我聽見一輛腳踏車呼地經過。

institutionalised.zh: 使制度化（institutionalise 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The company institutionalised weekly feedback sessions.
公司將每週的意見回饋會議制度化了。
These habits were institutionalised over many years.
這些習慣是經過多年才變成制度的。
Discrimination can become institutionalised in old systems.
在舊體制中，歧視可能變成制度化的問題。
It is an institutionalised practice in many schools.
這在許多學校是一種制度化的做法。
She loves the strong taste of licorice candy.
她愛甘草糖的濃烈味道。
Licorice root is sometimes used in herbal tea.
甘草根有時會用在草本茶裡。
The school wants to institutionalise the new reading program.
學校想把新的閱讀計畫制度化。
It takes time to institutionalise a new habit in a large company.
在大公司裡，要把新習慣制度化需要時間。
The lion opened its huge maw and roared.
獅子張開巨口怒吼。
The tunnel looked like the maw of a giant beast.
那條隧道看起來像巨獸的大口。
The Romans built a stone aqueduct to carry water to the city.
羅馬人建了一座石造水道把水送到城裡。
We walked beside the old aqueduct on our trip.
旅行時我們沿著古老的水道旁散步。
The firefighter received an award for gallantry.
那位消防員因英勇事蹟獲頒獎項。
His gallantry saved three people from the river.
他的英勇行為從河裡救了三個人。
I used a ticket as a bookmark.
我拿一張票券當書籤。
She slid the bookmark into the book and closed it.
她把書籤夾進書裡，然後闔上書。
The storm devastatingly hit the small coastal town.
暴風雨對這個海邊小鎮造成了毀滅性的打擊。
He was devastatingly honest about the results.
他對結果坦白得令人難以承受。

demoralised.zh: 使士氣低落（demoralise 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The long losing streak demoralised the whole team.
長期連敗讓整支球隊士氣低落。
Constant criticism demoralised the new workers.
不斷的批評使新員工士氣低落。

consuming.zh: 消耗；吃喝（consume 的現在分詞）
ai: The old heater is consuming a lot of electricity.
那台舊暖氣機耗了很多電。
He kept consuming snacks while watching the game.
他看比賽時一直在吃零食。

consuming.zh: 占據全部心思的；耗時的
ai: Her consuming passion for music filled her days.
她對音樂的狂熱占據了她所有的日子。
Filling out the forms was a time-consuming task.
填寫這些表格是件很耗時的事。
The two clocks run in a synchronous way.
這兩個時鐘同步運行。
Online classes can be synchronous or recorded.
線上課程可以是即時同步的，也可以是錄影的。
